BiblicalUsage: Jehudijah is a Jewess, the wife of Mered, named in the genealogy of Judah. In 1 Chronicles 4:18, his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jehudijah is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
